wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic IPO Updates: AI Giant Prepares to Start Trading in High-Stakes Offering
wsjHeadlines.description: Claude maker is first AI lab to go public after pricing shares at $83, above targeted range

wsjHeadlines.title: Dodgers Owner Walter Faces Probe From State Regulator That Says It Was ‘Misled’
wsjHeadlines.description: Delaware’s insurance department has joined federal authorities in investigating loans Walter’s insurers made to entities he also controls.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Bond Market’s Surprising Take on the AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, stocks pop as Anthropic sets a high IPO price.

wsjHeadlines.title: Four Ways Techruptions May Shape the Economy
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, the real debate at the Fed, more on Medicare for All, and could Congress cut tariffs?

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia Is the Central Bank to AI’s Circular Economy. See Where the Money Goes.
wsjHeadlines.description: The company has struck at least 293 deals since 2023 and amassed a more than $100 billion investment portfolio.

wsjHeadlines.title: Is Anthropic Worth $1.1 Trillion, or $1.5 Trillion? How to Make Sense of the Valuations
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s complex structure and funding make for confusing valuation math.

wsjHeadlines.title: What to Know About Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares in the maker of the Claude chatbot are set to begin trading midday Thursday.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Strong Fundamentals Give New CEO a Much-Needed Tailwind
wsjHeadlines.description: The company inherits problems from Jensen Huang, and advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: Why Big Investors Are Burning Lenders on Apartment Loans
wsjHeadlines.description: Deep-pocketed landlords like Brookfield may be the most willing to cut their losses on troubled properties.

wsjHeadlines.title: Big Tech Needs to Spread Its Bets on Data Centers
wsjHeadlines.description: Artificial-intelligence players that bet too much on a handful of mega projects look vulnerable after the midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gucci Is Cutting Prices. Louis Vuitton Is Reluctant to Follow the Trend.
wsjHeadlines.description: With luxury demand weak, executives are debating one of the sector’s big taboos.

wsjHeadlines.title: CVS Breakup Won’t Satisfy Washington. It Could Still Work for Wall Street.
wsjHeadlines.description: Spinning off its drugstores won’t quiet CVS’s critics, but it could leave shareholders with a more valuable company.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pledged to Mobilize $500 Billion for Nvidia—but Hasn’t Put Up a Dime
wsjHeadlines.description: A wave of money that was supposed to help customers keep buying Nvidia chips hasn’t materialized.

wsjHeadlines.title: JPMorgan Chase Names Bregje de Best to Succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO
wsjHeadlines.description: De Best joined JPMorgan in 2006 and has been finance chief of its commercial and investment bank since June 2025.

wsjHeadlines.title: Deutsche Bank Shares Drop After Leaks Put Spotlight on Troubled Past
wsjHeadlines.description: A media consortium reported on failings in the bank’s handling of high-risk customers, including Russian oligarchs and Jeffrey Epstein.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Chief Tells Jamie Dimon He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant, which is expected to begin trading Thursday, is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.33 trillion or more.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Bots Are Using Credit Cards. Banks Are Racing to Keep Up.
wsjHeadlines.description: Stripe is positioning itself as a key cog for agentic commerce, while JPMorgan Chase is a skeptic.

wsjHeadlines.title: Thousands of Anthropic Employees and Investors Are Set to Reap Fortunes
wsjHeadlines.description: A majority of the AI frontier lab’s more than 5,000 employees are expected to become millionaires.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on ZTO Express, Jeju Air, Jet2 and more in the latest Market Talks covering Auto and Transport.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Seatrium,  Ithaca Energy and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities..

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Kenanga Investment Bank, Challenger, Deutsche Bank and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on  Nvidia, Anthropic, Tokyo Electron and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Futures Rise Ahead of Anthropic Trading Debut
wsjHeadlines.description: Nasdaq futures led a rally in U.S. stocks premarket, after Anthropic’s pricing of its hotly anticipated listing lifted confidence around the AI trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Rise as Tech Sentiment Improves
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes largely rallied at the open as tech sentiment rebounded and industrial stocks gained.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Equities Mixed Amid Cautious Market Sentiment
wsjHeadlines.description: Expectations for higher interest rates and renewed concerns over technology stocks kept investors cautious.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Raises $81 Billion in Biggest IPO Ever
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant sold more shares than planned and priced the offering above the targeted range.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Sells More Shares Than Planned at a Higher Price Than Expected
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Pete Hegseth cemented a new military deal with Venezuela, and Nvidia’s blockbuster earnings failed to soothe investors’ nerves.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congrats on Your Anthropic Shares
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s IPO will benefit taxpayers and workers far and wide.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Can Nvidia Thrive Without Jensen Huang?
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s prospects depends on whether its board is able to avoid a series of common pitfalls.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Rational Investing and Stock-Market Bubbles
wsjHeadlines.description: Readers debate investor behavior and how markets price risk.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | What’s Really Behind Data Center Backlash
wsjHeadlines.description: Midterm results aren’t a rejection of the technology itself but of the way developers handle projects.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congressional Insider Trading Isn’t as Common as You Think
wsjHeadlines.description: As with Mr. Pelosi’s Alphabet options, many insider-trading claims fall apart under scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | ‘Peer-to-Peer’ Wagering Isn’t Gambling? Don’t Bet on It
wsjHeadlines.description: Kalshi says it is different from a sportsbook. Utah says Kalshi’s own trading arm acts like the house.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Alamtri, palm oil, metals futures and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials..

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Pressured by Rate-Hike Bets, Broader Commodities Retreat
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold prices continued to slip, with New York futures down 0.1% to $3,737.20.

wsjHeadlines.title: Time for Copper-Focused BHP to Show How It Can Grow
wsjHeadlines.description: The world’s most valuable miner is hosting an investor tour of its Australian copper operations next week, a year after it reassured investors that it had plenty of options to produce more copper as global demand for the metal swells.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Falls, Weighed by Larger-Than-Expected Rise in U.S. Inventories
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil fell in early Asian trading, weighed by a sharper-than-expected rise in U.S. crude oil inventories.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on metals futures, palm oil prices, BHP and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Could Stay Strong in 2027
wsjHeadlines.description: The DXY dollar index fell after reaching a 19-month high of 103.974 overnight. Deutsche Bank said the currency is likely to remain higher for longer due to the positive implications of the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.22% to 98.64
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.S. dollar rose to new 52-week highs after the minutes of the Federal Reserve’s October meeting revealed central bankers’ mounting inflation concerns.
